d:
From remote corners of the world to places steeped in history, Josh Gates takes on expeditions driven by curiosity and the search for answers. Along the way, unexpected discoveries, challenging terrain and fascinating stories make every journey an adventure of its own. Join Josh as he travels into the unknown, one expedition at a time!
Watch Expedition Unknown, S3, Episodes 3, 16, 12, 5 & 11; S4, Episodes 8, 11, 12 & 2; and S2, Episodes 18, 11, 5, 13 & 6 on Discovery Channel India.
